serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Hmm. I’m getting tired of the food I can get at the grocery near my place. … Now that I think about it. I saved up a bit of money! I could probably treat myself a bit. If I remember correctly there’s a shop for rich people around here. I have never been there, but I’ve heard people talking about it before. I can definitely buy at least something for {gv_money}$ Let’s see… I think it’s that way?
